fact: At the 21 March 2025 launch of SYC@D the director general of taxes said cadastral and geographic databases are integrated, interfaces exist with the ONI and DGI databases, and online cadastral extracts, attributions and cession orders are processed, with land revenue collection among its missions.
title: Gestion du foncier : Le Burkina se dote du SYC@D pour digitaliser l'accès aux titres de propriété
